# The Buggy Shop
> Australia's Premier Golf Buggy for Sale & Luxury All-Terrain Cart Specialists

Established in Queensland in 2004, The Buggy Shop is Australia's foremost destination for brand-new and certified used golf buggies for sale, remote control golf buggies, push golf buggies, off road buggies, and golf buggy accessories with nationwide hydraulic tail-lift delivery.

## Identity & Core Info
- **Established**: 2004 in Queensland, Australia
- **Headquarters**: Queensland, Australia
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +61 480 811 308 (Mon - Fri: 7:30 AM - 5:30 PM AEST | Sat: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM AEST)
- **Currency**: AUD (All prices include 10% Australian GST)
- **Nationwide Freight**: Flat-rate hydraulic tail-lift delivery to property gates and regional depots across Australia ($495 AUD).
- **Payment Methods**: Direct Bank Wire, Australian PayID, and Crypto (Bitcoin BTC / Tether USDT with an instant 10% discount).
- **Warranty**: 5-Year Domestic LiFePO4 Lithium Battery Replacement Warranty + 3-Year Chassis & Powertrain Warranty.
- **Road Compliance**: Pre-fitted state-compliant lighting, dual mirrors, horn, beacons, and pre-filled conditional registration paperwork for QLD TMR, Transport for NSW, and VicRoads.

- [Off-Road Buggies & Side-by-Side UTVs](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/off-road-buggies/): Dune buggies, farm UTVs, and heavy-duty 4x4 side-by-sides from GMX, Crossfire, Kayo, and Polaris.
- [Kids & Teen Ride-On Buggies](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/kids-buggies/): 48V electric and 90cc-208cc petrol off-road buggies with parental speed locks and heavy-duty roll cages ($850+ floor).

- [Certified Used & Ex-Demo Buggies](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/used-golf-buggies/): Workshop-inspected ex-demo MGI buggies and refurbished 48V lithium carts with comprehensive warranties.

- [Conditional Road Registration for Golf Buggies in QLD, NSW & VIC: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://DOMAIN.com/blog/conditional-road-registration-guide-qld-nsw-vic/): How to legally drive your golf buggy between properties, cross roads, and access golf communities with turnkey state-approved lighting and permits.
- [LiFePO4 Lithium vs Lead-Acid in Australian Extreme Heat: Why Lithium Wins Every Time](https://DOMAIN.com/blog/lifepo4-vs-lead-acid-battery-lifespan-australian-climate/): Why traditional lead-acid and AGM batteries fail prematurely in 40°C+ Australian outback heat, and how 72V LiFePO4 chemistry delivers 3,500+ charge cycles.
